agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes and no sensor noise; only initial omega=-0.22 with x=-0.24. Controller keeps pole upright (theta ~ -0.08, margin ~0.71 at step 223) using small force (~0.67 << limit 44) but fails to regulate cart position. Cart velocity becomes increasingly negative (-0.40 at step 100, -1.09 at step 200, -1.38 at step 223) and position drifts monotonically from -0.24 to -2.395 at step 222 (still inside) to -2.419 at step 223 outside track. Energy and external work grow from controller work but remain consistent. Counterfactual with omega=0 removes the persistent drift and stays well inside track, confirming the initial angular rate triggers the unbalanced position drift.
